_howToEdit: Change any wording below and save. Each habit has 5 weeks. 'dailyPrompt' is shown every day of that week, and 'openQuestion' is the free-text question in the daily check-in. The 'default' set is used for habit types that don't have their own.
commitmentQuestion: Did you maintain your commitment today?
cravingQuestion: How strong were cravings or impulses today?

weeks.dailyPrompt: Notice one moment today when you would usually have reached for a cigarette. What was happening just before it?
weeks.openQuestion: What intention are you holding for this week, in your own words?

weeks.focus: Noticing cravings in the body, and urge surfing
weeks.dailyPrompt: When an urge arrives today, pause and breathe with it for ten slow breaths before doing anything else.
weeks.openQuestion: Where did you notice the urge in your body?

weeks.focus: What a slip teaches, and returning to practice
weeks.dailyPrompt: Whatever happened today, notice how you speak to yourself about it.
weeks.openQuestion: What did today teach you about returning to your practice?

weeks.focus: What has changed, and what is sticking
weeks.dailyPrompt: Notice one thing that feels easier now than it did at the start.
weeks.openQuestion: What is starting to stick, and what is helping it stick?

weeks.focus: A final reflection, overlap and integration
weeks.dailyPrompt: Take a quiet moment to notice who you are becoming without cigarettes.
weeks.openQuestion: What do you want to carry forward after the cohort ends?

weeks.dailyPrompt: Notice one moment today when the old habit called to you. What was happening just before it?
weeks.openQuestion: What intention are you holding for this week, in your own words?

weeks.dailyPrompt: When an impulse arrives today, pause and breathe with it for ten slow breaths.
weeks.openQuestion: Where did you notice the impulse in your body?

weeks.focus: What a slip teaches, and returning to practice
weeks.dailyPrompt: Whatever happened today, notice how you speak to yourself about it.
weeks.openQuestion: What did today teach you about returning to your practice?

weeks.focus: What has changed, and what is sticking
weeks.dailyPrompt: Notice one thing that feels easier now than it did at the start.
weeks.openQuestion: What is starting to stick, and what is helping it stick?

weeks.dailyPrompt: Take a quiet moment to notice what has changed for you.
weeks.openQuestion: What do you want to carry forward after the cohort ends?
